_comment: Board settings template. Copy to settings.json (gitignored). The backend auto-creates settings.json on first boot and the UI writes it as you change settings, so copying this is optional. Keys below are every setting the code reads.
_workingDirectory: Absolute path to the folder that holds your repos. The Changes view, the web terminal, and spawned agents all resolve against it. In the container this is the /workspace mount (seeded from ATRIUM_WORKING_DIRECTORY).
_agents_enabled: System-wide switch for the 'run an agent on this task' feature. Set false to hide/deny it for everyone.
_default_priority: Priority preselected in the New Task form: low | medium | high.
_default_type: Type preselected in the New Task form: frontend | backend | fullstack | devops.
_optional: The keys below are optional and usually set via the UI, not by hand.
_claudeBin: Absolute path to the claude executable, if it isn't on PATH (overrides lib/claudeBin resolution).
_github_token: GitHub token for the Changes view's PR badges. Prefer the GH_TOKEN env var; this is the settings-based fallback. Redacted from GET /api/settings responses.
_setup_completed_at: ISO timestamp the first-run wizard writes when dismissed. Managed by the app; do not set by hand.
